THE NEXT LOOK OF BLACKOUT DASH

Your bike. Your line.

Your bike accelerates automatically. Use ← / → to steer, ↑ to jump, and ↓ to brake. Space kicks nearby rivals. Bike contact can knock riders down; they recover automatically. Jump barriers and oil. Stay low under overhead gates. Brake or switch lanes when electric zones glow red.

Race against computer riders on this device. Choose 2, 4, 6 or 8 racers; no other users are needed.

    3

    Bike moves forward automatically. ← / → steer · ↑ jump · Hold ↓ to brake; release to ride again. Space: kick a nearby rival · Touch: use the buttons. Esc / Exit race view returns to page view.

    01 / READ THE ROAD

    Choose your escape.

    Yellow barriers, oil spills and moving roadblocks: jump or steer around. Blue overhead gates: stay grounded. Pink lasers and red pulse zones: wait or change lane.

    02 / RIDE CLEAN

    Speed with a little strategy.

    Earn 10 points per 100 units. Each obstacle hit takes 50 points and slows your bike briefly. A fall costs 25 points. Kicks recharge in 2.5 seconds; fallen riders recover after 1.35 seconds and briefly resist further contact. First to finish wins. The race ends after 90 seconds.

    03 / A FULL STARTING GRID

    One road. Up to eight riders.

    Ride through mountains, downtown, a lakeside road and a sky bridge. Your race rank counts all riders. Only nearby rivals appear on the highway. The progress strip tracks everyone, even riders far ahead or behind. No lane scrolling.
